notes.title: Update 1.07
notes.notes:
[b]Update 1.07[/b]
-Fixed important framerate drops in some areas.
-Improved overall performance of all levels

notes.title: Update 1.06
notes.notes:
[b]Mise à jour 1.06[/b]
-New tiles added
-Endless Mode now unlocked by defaut
-Balance and optimization on some areas

notes.title: Update 1.05
notes.notes:
[b]Update 1.05[/b]
-Added gamma setting in options menu
-Performance optimization of certain areas

notes.title: Update 1.03
notes.notes:
[b]Patchnotes 1.03 : [/b]

-Overall game difficulty balance
-Multiple phase 3 levels adjusted
-Obstacles positions and spawn rates changes for phase 2 and 3
-Improved jump system - improved feeling and reactivity 
-Score now increase exponentially when reaching phase 2 and phase 3
-Ui adjustment for the leaderboards
-Main Menu improvement 
-Various minor fixes

notes.title: Patchnotes 1.02
notes.notes:
[b]Minor Fixes[/b]
- Default Input settings
- Jump hitboxes fixes for some tiles
- Fixed some obstacles spawn that could cause collision issues
- Other Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Endless Nesla is now out !
notes.notes:
Endless Nesla is finally here! Discover the Nesla ship, run as far as possible, find the hidden data and compete against other players on the online leaderboard !
